en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a large multi‑storey historic school building with many regularly spaced windows, a mansard roof with small towers, and decorative façades. In front of the building is a tree‑lined street with a few pedestrians and a small park or green area in the foreground. Printed German text at the top identifies the location and the institution depicted.
